subject: Webinar: speaker briefing, A/V needs, and calendar alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Webinar — speaker briefing, A/V needs, and calendar alignment

Hi team,

We have DataWave confirmed as our external guest for the July 29th webinar (Dr. Jenna Park + Samir Khan). I want to lock the internal speaker lineup and make sure we have the tech/run-of-show items covered. High-level asks:

- Confirm who will handle the 5-minute intro + 3 quick product hits (we usually keep this tight).
- Confirm who will moderate Q&A and monitor chat.
- Identify any special A/V or demo requirements (Dev, please advise if you need a staging model state or demo tokens).
- Can someone send a compact intro (40–60 words) and headshot for Dr. Park? We have a co-marketing blurb to publish.

I've attached a draft agenda and our speaker guidelines. Can you reply by EOD Wednesday with availability for a 20-minute tech check window on July 28th? Preferable windows: 10:00–11:00 PT or 15:00–16:00 PT.

Thanks — I can own calendar invites once we confirm.

—Marissa
Marketing Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Webinar — speaker briefing, A/V needs, and calendar alignment

Thanks Marissa — I can take the 5-minute intro and do the short product highlights (slide 1–3). Happy to moderate Q&A as well if Dylan is OK to handle the live demo handoff.

I can do the July 28th tech check at 15:00 PT.

For Dr. Park intro: I'll reach out to Jenna and ask for a 50-word bio + a headshot.

Quick note on slides: we should ask external speakers to submit a single slide deck (one deck per speaker) 24 hours before the event. That keeps versioning simple.

—Ava
Events Lead | Redwood Inference
From: Dr. Jenna Park <j.park@datawave.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.k@datawave.ai>
Date: 2026-07-16T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Webinar — speaker briefing, A/V needs, and calendar alignment

Hi Marissa & Ava,

Thanks for the invite — excited to participate. July 28th at 10:00 PT works for us for the tech check (Samir and I are both free then). We'll send a 50-word bio and headshot by end of day Monday (7/20).

One ask: Samir will showcase a short demo with a 2-minute pre-recorded clip. Can you confirm whether you can play embedded video from a shared Slides deck, or should we upload the clip to YouTube/private link?

Best,
Jenna
Chief Product Officer | DataWave AI
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Webinar — speaker briefing, A/V needs, and calendar alignment

Heads up on tech: embedded video from Slides sometimes stutters in our WebEx/streaming flow. For reliability please ask DataWave to provide either (a) a 720p MP4 we host and stream from our CDN, or (b) a private YouTube link. We can stage the demo model in a read-only environment and pre-load the model weights for the session — but I need the clip 48 hours before to do a dry run.

Also: please confirm whether we'll allow file downloads during the session (I recommend no). If we do allow, we should provision a short-lived signed URL.

I'll join the tech check and can take the demo handoff from Dylan if needed.

—Dev
Senior Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Jenna Park <j.park@datawave.ai>, Samir Khan <samir.k@datawave.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-28T16:35:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: tech check time + calendar invites sent

Thanks everyone — quick confirmations: 

- Tech check set for July 28th at 10:00 PT (per Jenna's availability). Invite sent to internal and external participants (link above).
- DataWave to upload a 720p MP4 of the demo clip to the shared Drive folder by 7/26 EOD — Samir confirmed offline.
- Ava: please collect the 50-word bio + headshot from Dr. Park and drop into the Drive folder.
- Dev: we'll plan to stream the MP4 from our CDN; please run the dry run during the tech check and validate playback.
- Dylan: you'll do the live demo handoff; Dev will own the backend readiness.

Attachments: rwi_webinar_agenda_v1.pdf; speaker_guidelines.docx (see Drive).

I'll publish the final speaker lineup and a minute-by-minute timeline after the tech check.

—Marissa
Marketing Programs | Redwood Inference
